name: tasklines
description: Show inline checkbox tasks in Bases as a table, a board, an urgent-and-important matrix or a calendar, with each note’s properties as columns. Filter, sort, group, color, tick and edit tasks in place.

scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
scripts.perf-vault: npm run build && node bench/make-perf-vault.mjs perf-vault 5000 && cp bench/perf-in-obsidian.js perf-vault/perf.js
